runId.description: Echoed on every run.progress notification so a caller can tell runs apart.

root.description: The workspace root, like the store methods.

collection.description: The collection folder, relative to root.

environment.description: An environment's name (case-insensitive), its file name without extension, or its relative path. An unknown one is -32602 and lists the available names.

variables.description: Values that outrank collection, environment and runtime scopes. Values of 4 or more characters are masked as *** wherever they resurface in results.

network.description: The proxy every request in the run goes through. The desktop shell sets it from the user's settings and ignores any value from the renderer.

allowAbsoluteFiles.description: Whether a request may read a file by absolute path. Relative paths always resolve against the collection folder and must stay inside it. The desktop shell forces this to false; the command line sets it to true.

requestResult.description: One request's outcome. `url` is as written, placeholders unresolved, so a secret in a query string never reaches a report.

error.description: Why no response was obtained: transport or configuration. Present means the request errored.

passed.description: True when a response arrived and every assertion passed. A request with no assertions passes on any response.

captures.description: What each capture did, by name. The captured values themselves are never part of a result, and are masked wherever they resurface. Omitted when the request has none.

environment.description: The environment's display name; absent when none was used.

failed.description: Got a response but failed an assertion.

requests.description: In run order: sidebar order, folders before requests, each group by display name.

run.progress.description: Notification (no id), sent after each request finishes, before the run.collection response.
